orchestrator_fixes_round_1.mutation-anchors: THIRD red test, and not caused by either of the first two fixes. The triage role copies the reviewer's tool grant byte for byte, so `    tools: [read, write, grep, find, ls]` stopped being unique in fleet.example.yaml and collation-contract.battery.ts's RV15/RV16 matched it 2x. A two-match anchor mutates whichever line the replacer reaches first, so those entries would have kept passing while testing something other than their `what:`. Re-anchored through append_system_prompt_file: ./roles/reviewer.md, which is the spelling RV17 already used for the live config. TWO GOTCHAS worth keeping: mutation-anchors.test.ts reads BOTH the battery and its target at git HEAD, so a working-tree fix looks like it changed nothing until committed; and it truncates the anchor to 70 chars in the message, so a re-anchored entry still prints as the bare line it used to be.
